intent_contract.text: 이번엔 노출도 있는 의상으로 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently define a visually complex photorealistic revealing-fashion render test in which the outfit keeps opaque coverage over the breasts and pelvis, while reserving the supplied image for post-core appearance-reference handling.

Create a photorealistic environmental fashion editorial featuring one unmistakably adult woman, about 30, inside a decommissioned coastal cable-car terminal built into a sea cliff at blue hour after rain. She plants one boot on the grated service platform and pulls a waist-high red brake lever with both hands as an empty gondola begins to roll past the open portal behind her; her taut posture, the lever angle, and the moving cabin make the action immediately legible. She wears a revealing editorial outfit with opaque fabric covering her breasts and pelvis. Salt mist threads through the machinery, wet steel reflects amber maintenance lamps, and the distant ocean flashes beneath storm clouds. Prioritize clear adult presentation and readable hand-to-lever action, then the contrast between rain-sheened skin, weathered industrial textures, and deep coastal scale. Capture crisp skin and fabric detail, believable rain residue, layered cables and pulleys, and controlled motion in the passing gondola.
